title: latency-islands-and-backpressure-classifier-dashboard
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an integrated observability featureset that identifies persistent latency "islands" and classifies backpressure/failure modes across the serving stack. Deliverables: (1) tracing hook additions to surface queue/backpressure signals and model runtime errors, (2) metrics/log pipeline parsers to synthesize 'island' events and error fingerprints, (3) a Grafana dashboard (and dashboard JSON) that surfaces latency islands, correlated failure taxonomy (timeouts, queue/backpressure, kernel OOMs, model decode errors, HTTP/gRPC error codes), and a compact timeline for incident triage.
acceptance_criteria: Tracing spans emitted for 95% of production requests with new attributes: routing_tier, queue_time_ms, kernel_selection, kv_cache_hit, model_error_code, batch_size
Pipeline parsers reliably map HTTP/gRPC codes to taxonomy buckets and produce daily aggregates in ClickHouse (backfill for 30 days)
Grafana dashboard contains: latency-islands heatmap, per-model failure fingerprint table, backpressure funnel, and drilldown links to traces and PRs
Automated alert rule for 'island growth' that triggers paging when a model-route's p95 latency increases by >40% over a 30m baseline
activity: 2025-01-17: Kickoff with Observability, Runtime, and Platform teams. Agreed on three-phased rollout: instrumentation -> pipeline -> dashboard/alerts.
2025-01-22: Prototype tracing hook implemented in runtime (branch: feature/trace-queue-attrs). Local tests show queue_time_ms and kernel_selection attributes populated for sync and streaming paths.
2025-01-29: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/3421. Initial review by @sarah and @liam. Requested changes on sampling and attribute naming conventions.
2025-02-03: Observability infra design doc published: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Latency+Islands+Design. Includes ClickHouse schema and synthetic event examples.
2025-02-10: Pipeline prototype (kafka->log-transform->clickhouse) deployed to staging. Backfill script validated on 7 days of prod-like traffic.
2025-02-18: Dashboard wireframe reviewed with PM and SRE. Feedback: add per-region split and explicit mapping for 429/503 -> backpressure vs capacity saturation.

2025-02-25: Model error taxonomy agreed: TIMEOUT, QUEUE_TIMEOUT, BACKPRESSURE, KERNEL_OOM, DECODE_ERROR, MODEL_EXCEPTION, HTTP_4XX_CLIENT, HTTP_5XX_SERVER, GRPC_UNAVAILABLE. Mapping rules committed in parser config (repo: observability/pipeline).
2025-02-28: Implemented alert prototype and smoke-tested on staging with injected latency. Next: address reviewer comments on PR #3421 and start authoring dashboard JSON for Grafana.
notes: Design decisions and trade-offs: we will emit additional span attributes at the cost of ~0.6% CPU for the runtime sidecar; agreed acceptable for P1 routes. Sampling: default 100% for error traces, 5% for success traces; configurable per-route. We chose ClickHouse for event aggregation because of large-cardinality group-bys and affordable day-30 retention. Follow-ups: (a) apply fingerprint deduping to reduce alert noise, (b) integrate with Console rollouts to show if a canary causes island growth.
